question: In a code language, ‘BEAM’ is written as ‘AFZN’, and ‘BILL’ is written as ‘AJKM’. How will ‘WELL’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is:​

‘BEAM’ is written as ‘AFZN’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ad38f974b51dec65800faafd3f37d6d8a7e4ed2e5511e069db0e4ed61693b89.png] 

And,

‘BILL’ is written as ‘AJKM’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c4ffcd793141e516ac4745427d84d22a814b773cab7ebe8d35f4085dd906f29.png] 

Similarly,

‘WELL’ will be written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0a7708dfcd86a84ff26997f7a0a8284da6430a0ca6d512de1af023ee786d13e.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
